lines.trans: Earlier I trusted Eduard Valentinovich.
And now I understand that he is deceiving me.
So that means I have a chance now?
Well, on the whole I find you likable.
So what is the problem then?
I still know you very poorly.
Here I am, sitting right in front of you.
Ask about anything, I will answer honestly.
About absolutely anything at all?
Yes, about absolutely everything in the world.
Only you must not deceive me.
For a former official, that is very hard to do.
But I will definitely try not to lie.
